description: This PHP script initializes and renders a page for managing and viewing request system data within the TestLink project. It sets up necessary objects, loads configuration, retrieves data, and displays it using Smarty templates. It also includes functions for argument initialization and access rights checking.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic empty class used for creating simple objects for data storage.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing arguments and user session data for page rendering.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the rights to view or manage the request system data.
